Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk acknowledges your complaint that the handling of your companion animal during the disrupted departure did not meet the standard you were promised, and we are treating the matter with urgency.

We understand the concern this has caused, especially where a pet is involved, and we are reviewing the chain of events with the ground team and the supervising staff who managed the transfer. Our operations record has been opened, and the circumstances around the carrier movement, handoff timing, and station coordination are now under active review. We do not dismiss the distress created when a journey for a companion animal is interrupted, and we are taking your report as a priority service issue.

<<FACT F119>> 
That claim window is the limit we must apply, so if you intend to seek review on the basis of the minor injury, please submit the required materials within that period and keep copies of any veterinary notes, receipts, and travel documents. We need those records to move quickly and to keep the assessment aligned with the policy that governs animal travel incidents.

<<FACT F109>> 
That payout is the standard amount linked to this kind of delayed departure, and it is processed only after the review confirms eligibility under the service terms. If your case involves any additional loss or care need, the assessor will separate that from the standard payout and handle it through the normal claims path.

To keep this moving, our desk will coordinate with the station team, confirm the report trail, and ensure the supervising manager has the full account. If there was any lapse in care or communication, it will be addressed directly. We know that passengers rely on Aurelia Skyways to treat companion travel as a shared responsibility, and we are not lowering that standard.

Please reply through the same case channel with your supporting documents so we can proceed without delay. If you need help organizing the claim packet, our team will guide you through the next steps in a clear and practical way.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
